source: Bärenreiter BA 4565, Recitativo after No. 21 (Atto terzo, Scena X). The decode runs the Countess's "prendi una spilla … del foglio" (bars 3-7) into Susanna's speech, and does not read the words written on the letter ("Rimandate il sigillo", bar 7); both written as in Da Ponte's libretto. Its first decoded syllable ("-rà") ends No. 21
